calls: every call the recorder made to a product export (function, class constructor `new X`, instance method `X#m`) with its arguments viewed at call time, in order; an argument over 4000 bytes of JSON is stored once in the set `shared` table and referenced as {"$shared": n}
compare: mixdog-agent send.rs:541-664 (retry loop, advised wait, reasons), mixdog-ai retry decider.rs:55-57,172-185 and retry advice.rs, openai adapter.rs: feed each case's scripted errors / midState and compare `results`, `progress`, `sleeps`, `details`, `traces`, `stages` and the error fields. K1 gap G10 (exhaustion surfaces the first error, not the last) and G1 (xAI WS carry-forward) are OPEN in the core, so those cases are expected to differ.

describedValues.{\"$instance\": name, constructedWith: [: an instance of a product class, as the arguments it was constructed with
describedValues.{\"$response\": {status, statusText, hea: a fetch Response handed to the product: status, headers (in order) and the body chunks as delivered (bytes)
describedValues.{\"$stream\": [chunk...]}: an async stream the recorder handed the product, as the chunks it yields in order
describedValues.{\"callback\": name}: a function the recorder handed the product; its scripted behaviour is the case body

entry: src/runtime/agent/orchestrator/providers/openai-ws-send-attempts.mjs createWsSendAttempts(opts) / openai-ws-send/send-context.mjs createWsSendContext(opts), provider-error-kind.mjs retryReasonClass / safeRetryErrorCode, retry-executor.mjs emitProviderRetryStage, stall-policy.mjs providerTimeoutError. The state-machine cases feed a scripted Error (own properties are the inputs) and read `attempts.state` and the error objects after each call; the `ws-*` cases run sendViaWebSocket over a real loopback WebSocket.
exclusions: NOT HELD (not reproducible at the wire): stream-stored-xai-anchor-carried-into-next-attempt (:464) - tried: two sends on one pool key with auth xai and store:true over the real sender; the second send dials a new socket instead of reusing the first (recorded in the attempt, no anchored entry exists when the retry starts) and its retry frame carries no previous_response_id, so the Node test state (an entry holding resp_1) is only reachable on a hand-built entry

NOT HELD (observable nowhere outside Node objects): token-refresh-timeout-classifies-as-auth (:345) - the classification of a token-refresh timeout error is read from the error object of the auth refresh (an HTTP exchange with the auth server outside this socket); exhausted-falls-back-to-first-error-or-unreachable-marker (:478) - the explicit unreachable marker is the return value of an internal accessor of a send that ended without any attempt, a state no send reaches

NOT HELD HERE, recorded at the wire in provider-openai-ws-stream: typed-timeouts-keep-their-own-wording (:325) - the wording of the typed first-byte / idle / first-output timeouts is the message of the error the send surfaces (cases prestream-watchdog-closes-silent-socket-first-byte-timeout, inter-chunk-stall-after-output-rejects-as-continuation, no-output-aborted-at-first-output-deadline, semantic-idle-applies-after-first-output)
reconnect-stage-names-failure-and-counts-down-advised-wait (:181) is the stage events of ws-rate-limited-response-failed-waits-advised-time and ws-long-advised-wait-announced-before-it-starts
result.error.props.transportTiming.*Ms and result.result.transportTiming.*Ms of the ws-* cases: performance.now() durations of the real clock, written as a marker (the keys stay)

no string is rewritten: the data directory is the fixed D:/mixdog-build/tmp/w22/<set> and the product tree D:/mixdog-build/tmp/b6f-tree (paths as Node produced them, Windows separators where Node wrote them): a replay maps its own temp directory to that prefix

net requests: the VALUES of the request headers x-stainless-os, x-stainless-arch and x-stainless-runtime-version (the SDK client stack writes the recording host's OS, architecture and Node version) are replaced by the marker `<recording host <header name>>` at exactly those header names; every other header is recorded and compared as it arrived
net requests: the recorder's x-bench-origin header is left out and `host` is the host of the origin the product addressed (the loopback port is random)

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay: Rust entry (pub, on o1): mixdog_ai::broker ModelBroker::send (broker/send.rs:75) with mixdog_ai::retry StandardRetryDecider (retry/decider.rs:35), retry::classify::kind_of (retry/classify.rs:142) and retry::advice::from_headers (retry/advice.rs:25). The helper createWsSendAttempts / createWsSendContext have no Rust item of that name: the behaviour is the broker's retry loop; the first-error-with-cause exhaustion is K1 G10, work for the Rust side.
values: exact (benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/lib/exact.mjs): every input, argument list, result and error is stored through the shared encoder; what JSON cannot hold is a {"$exact": <kind>} tag
